findings.method: Primary vector rules plus actual native code anchors in the same column; words ordered by visual baselines. Extractor bbox used only to disambiguate repeated code occurrence, never as the body boundary.

limits: Ruled native columns only; unavailable geometry/anchors remain unverified, not absent.
Strict physical prefix candidates need role/documentary review. This is not SourceWhole reconciliation.

quality.meaning: Execution, code transcription and primary-document reconciliation are separate; OCR execution completion is not glyph or pedagogical verification. An OCR code-like token does not certify an official printed code.
